persona_name: Jarrah, used-car buyer on his phone

persona_profile.name: Jarrah, used-car buyer on his phone
persona_profile.summary: 31, self-employed, renting in Indooroopilly. Just bought a used 2018 Kia Sorento diesel on a car loan: unrepaired hail damage, tow bar fitted, not insured yet. Keeps his old car until it sells. His partner (26, NZ licence) drives it sometimes. Unsure of the exact badge. New-build address the lookup won't find.
behaviours: takes the 'unsure' route when he doesn't know an answer
focus: untested branches: unrepaired damage Yes, finance, not insured, no home, younger driver, foreign licence

result.summary: Mobile run through 40 steps of the live car journey, taking untested branches: Diesel, badge 'unsure', TPFT, accessories (tow bar), unrepaired damage, finance, occasional business, not insured, manual address, car park, self-employed, no comprehensive in 12 months, 1 claim, second car, renting, younger driver with a foreign licence, 25+ restriction. Stopped at contact details.
result.persona_verdict: Mostly easy on my phone, but it quietly put my address in the wrong suburb, and I had to stab at a couple of tiny links.
result.coverage_notes: Found 4 steps not seen before (standard_options, non_standard_accessories, passengers_payment, goods_payment) plus 4 younger-driver steps. Not covered: rego lookup (prod rule), results, Lease finance, Business Only, Learners/Provisional licences, desktop.

findings.title: Manual address: suburb silently pre-selected (first alphabetical) after postcode
findings.observed: Manual address entry, postcode 4068: the Suburb dropdown auto-selected 'Chelmer' (first of Chelmer / Indooroopilly / Taringa), showed it green as valid and enabled Next. The field sits below the fold on mobile.
findings.expected: No default when a postcode has several suburbs; require an explicit choice (auto-select only a single-suburb postcode).
findings.persona_impact: Quote and policy priced for the wrong suburb without the customer noticing.
findings.suggested_fix: Default the suburb select to an empty 'Select suburb' option and validate it as required when there are multiple suburbs.

findings.title: Typing a whole date of birth in one go keeps only the day; the rest is silently lost
findings.observed: Typing 01011980 into DD kept '01' and left MM and YYYY empty; no auto-advance, no message. Same on the regular-driver DOB in the 6 Nov run.
findings.expected: Auto-advance between DD/MM/YYYY, or accept a full date pasted or typed into the first box.
findings.suggested_fix: Auto-advance focus when a segment is full and distribute pasted/typed overflow across the fields.

findings.title: Modifications help covers the whole question on mobile and doesn't say whether accessories count
findings.observed: On a 375px phone the '?' popover covers the question and both answers. It defines modifications but not whether an accessory already declared (tow bar) counts.
findings.expected: Help that doesn't hide the answers; a line on accessories vs modifications.
findings.persona_impact: Unsure customers guess; a wrong answer can affect a claim.
findings.suggested_fix: Render help inline below the question on small screens; add 'Accessories you declared on the previous step are not modifications'.

findings.title: Small inline text links need a precise tap on mobile ('click here', 'Enter it manually')
findings.observed: Thumb taps on 'click here' (badge unsure) and 'Enter it manually' missed and did nothing; both worked only with an exact tap. axe target-size also fails on the series list.
findings.suggested_fix: Make these links buttons or add padding so the tap area is at least 44px tall.

findings.title: Foreign licence branch asks nothing about country or time driving in Australia
findings.observed: Choosing Foreign Licence goes straight to 'age licence received'; no country, conversion or years-in-Australia question.
findings.expected: Confirm with product whether insurers on the panel need this; if so, ask it here rather than at the insurer.

findings.title: 'Yes' to unrepaired hail damage has no follow-up or explanation of impact
findings.observed: After Yes the journey moves straight on; no question about extent and no note that some insurers may exclude or decline.
findings.expected: A short note on what happens next, or a follow-up if insurers need detail.

findings.title: Accessibility: Invalid ARIA markup, so the tab state may be announced wrongly (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)
findings.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-allowed-attr' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
findings.expected: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
findings.suggested_fix: aria-selected=" true " is not allowed (stray spaces) See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-allowed-attr

findings.title: Accessibility: Tabs aren't inside a tab list, so they aren't announced as tabs (standard_options, WCAG 1.3.1)
findings.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-required-parent' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/standard_options. e.g. #factory:
findings.expected: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require parent roles are contained by them
findings.suggested_fix: Required ARIA parent role not present: tablist See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-required-parent

findings.title: Accessibility: An ARIA value is malformed (e.g. ' true ' with spaces) (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)
findings.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-valid-attr-value' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
findings.expected: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values
findings.suggested_fix: Invalid ARIA attribute value: aria-selected=" true " See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-valid-attr-value

findings.title: Accessibility: Text too faint to read comfortably (15 steps, WCAG 1.4.3)
findings.observed: 30 element(s) fail axe rule 'color-contrast' (, axe impact serious) on 15 step(s): /car-insurance, /car-insurance/journey/start, /car-insurance/journey/standard_options, /car-insurance/journey/car_address, /car-insurance/journey/car_make, /car-insurance/journey/car_year, /car-insurance/journey/car_model, /car-insurance/journey/non_standard_accessories …. e.g. .text-greyscale-300 > p:
findings.expected: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA

findings.title: Accessibility: A form field has no name, so it's announced as just 'edit text' (car_address, WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2)
findings.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'label' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.buildingName:
findings.expected: Ensure every form element has a label
findings.suggested_fix: Building Name input has no programmatic label See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/label

findings.title: Accessibility: A link looks like plain text (colour is the only difference) (car_address, WCAG 1.4.1)
findings.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'link-in-text-block' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #overnightParkingAddressToggle:
findings.expected: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text without relying on color
findings.suggested_fix: Link contrast 1.3:1 with surrounding text and no underline See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/link-in-text-block

findings.title: Accessibility: A control is nested inside another, so focus and announcements break (start, WCAG 4.1.2)
findings.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'nested-interactive' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/start. e.g. .registration_number__none__tEhej:
findings.expected: Ensure interactive controls are not nested

findings.title: Accessibility: A scrolling box can't be reached or scrolled with the keyboard (car-insurance, WCAG 2.1.1)
findings.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'scrollable-region-focusable' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #david-koch-car-insurance-transcript:
findings.expected: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard
findings.suggested_fix: Element should be focusable or contain focusable content See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/scrollable-region-focusable

findings.title: Accessibility: A dropdown has no name; users don't know what they're choosing (car_address, WCAG 4.1.2)
findings.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'select-name' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.unitType:
findings.expected: Ensure select element has an accessible name
findings.suggested_fix: Unit type and Suburb selects have no accessible name See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/select-name

findings.title: Accessibility: Tap targets are too small to hit reliably (car_series, WCAG 2.5.8)
findings.observed: 9 element(s) fail axe rule 'target-size' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_series. e.g. #internal-link-KIA\ 18AQ:
findings.expected: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
findings.suggested_fix: Target partially obscured (345px by 10px); should be at least 24px by 24px See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/target-size

rechecks.note: Bundled consent checkbox unchanged on mobile.
Badge 'unsure' list for 2018 Sorento: four UM variants with identical specs; only the badge differs.
TPFT offered and accepted for a 2018 Sorento with no market-value check; help popovers cover options on mobile.
DOB Next looks disabled with a valid date; tapping it works (visual only).
Address page title still 'Cover Type - Car Quote'.
Car Park and Parking Lot both offered.
~4-6s blank or faded screen per step on mobile; 7,296 console messages over the session.
Fast typing 1995 in YYYY stored correctly on mobile. Digit-dropping on one-go entry reproduced (see new finding).
Likely a false positive: 'None' full years is valid after Yes (insured under 12 months). After No, the 5-year option is correctly removed.
